guides.title: Before you break ground
guides.intro: A clear brief makes a stronger starting point.
points: Describe how the property needs to work for you, now and in the future.
Bring your site location, available drawings and any existing site information.
Outline your budget range and preferred timeline so priorities can be discussed early.

guides.title: A property that works for you
guides.intro: Know what you want from a management partner.
points: List your properties, their occupancy and any maintenance concerns.
Bring existing tenancy records and explain how rent is currently collected.
Discuss the reporting, inspection and communication arrangements you need.

guides.title: See the potential in your space
guides.intro: Start with what needs to change and why.
points: Identify the spaces that are not working and the improvements that matter most.
Gather photos, existing plans and details of known structural or maintenance issues.
Explain whether the property will remain occupied while work is carried out.

faqs: Can I engage Rakentaa for just one service?
Yes. Each of our six core services can be commissioned independently, or combined into an end-to-end arrangement. Tell us where you are in your project and we can discuss an appropriate scope.
I already have drawings or a contractor. Can you still help?
Yes. Our construction project management service supports clients who already have designs or a contractor and need independent coordination of budgets, schedules and quality.
How is the cost of my project determined?

We begin with your brief, location, scope and timeline. Design requirements, materials and site conditions inform the cost discussion. A project-specific budget and scope should be agreed before work begins.
Do you only work in Kampala?
We are based in Kampala and are set up to mobilise to other locations. Share your project location so we can discuss access, logistics and the services required.
What should I prepare for a first conversation?

Bring your project location, objectives, approximate budget and preferred timeline. Existing drawings, site photographs and property records are helpful where available. It is fine to start with an idea.
What happens when I submit the appointment form?
The form prepares a project brief that you can send to our team through WhatsApp. You review and confirm sending in WhatsApp. You can also call us directly to discuss an appointment.
